question_text: A Reservation currently stores only customer_id. A reusable Customer class will now hold customer details independently of reservations. Outline two changes that let reservations refer to Customer objects.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Add a customer reference attribute to Reservation and accept/store it during initialization. Update methods that need customer details to call that referenced object’s interface. Customers can exist independently and be referenced by several reservations, an aggregation relationship.

marking_points.criterion: Reference attribute replaces/augments ID as specified.
Methods use the referenced object’s interface.
Explains independent lifetime/shared references or consistent updating of callers.
